messages:
mia: Quick design sync 1: heatmap + p95 scrubber interaction when sampling is enabled. dropped mock in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def
owen: saw it, nice. main concern: scrubber preview shows raw sampled p95 and looks noisy. users think that is the truth.
sara: Agreed. Suggestion: adorn the preview with a micro-tag and a tooltip. Tag text options: 'Sampled estimate' / 'Estimate' / 'Sampled (X%)'.
dan: For heatmap cells we could add a tiny dot indicator for low-sample tiles, not a full label per-tile. Global header pill shows aggregate sample rate.
ethan: Dev constraints: calling full-aggregates on drag is expensive. We can do a cheap extrapolated_estimate from sampled data server-side if client requests include_extrapolated=true. cheaper than full scan and much stabler than raw sample.
mia: UX options in figma: A) show sampled p95 + small gray pill 'Sampled estimate (10%)' B) show sampled p95 + confidence band (p95 +/- delta) C) show extrapolated estimate from backend when available.
owen: I prefer B for visual parity with charts. Show band behind numeric value and a dashed outline on the scrubber preview.
sara: copy nit: tooltip lead with plain sentence: 'Based on 10% sample. Confidence interval: 480ms- 860ms.' Compact tooltip alt: '10% sample, low confidence.'
dan: Accessibility: pill must not rely on color. include icon (warning) for low sample and sr-only full phrase. Ensure role="status" for live updates while scrubbing.
ethan: Keyboard behavior: tab focus to handle, arrows move in steps, space toggles drag mode, escape cancels. On entering drag mode announce 'Scrubber active, showing sampled estimate, 12:34 PM'.
mia: Motion: when sampling toggles (user flips sample toggle) the scrubber could jump. Plan: animate crossfade between data sources unless prefers-reduced-motion is set, then snap. Add 'data-source-changed' transient toast: 'Values updated: now showing sampled estimates'.
owen: Edge case: if sample_rate < 5% show red microbadge 'Very low sample  use caution' and add an affordance 'Request full recalculation' (backend job).
sara: Analytics: record ui.scrubber.sample_badge_shown and ui.scrubber.recalc_requested. Include sample_rate and source (heatmap|scrubber|header).
dan: Mobile: pill should collapse into chart header overflow. avoid per-tile indicators on small screens.
ethan: Implementation detail: CI rendering: use translucent fill with border and small chevrons at end for clarity at small heights. Use outlined ARIA labels for hi-contrast themes.
mia: microcopy suggestions: badge short: 'Sampled estimate'; badge alt detailed: 'Metric is estimated from X% of requests; confidence interval shown when available.'
owen: Also include a docs link in tooltip: 'What does sampling mean?' -> /docs/observability/sampling.
sara: I'll write final copy and a short a11y checklist. dan, can you add keyboard mock in figma frames?
dan: yes, adding keyboard frames now. ETA EOD.
ethan: I'll add server support for include_extrapolated and event hooks.
assistbot: Reminder queued  run accessibility pass after copy finalization.
mia: Great. Next steps: sara finalizes copy + sr text; dan updates figma keyboard flows; ethan does backend spike for extrapolation; owen reviews mobile collapse. Reconvene tomorrow morning.
